item.title: Default topic rows at parity with the current app; Favoris tab title (#817, #857, #975)
item.body:
Closes #817
Closes #857
Closes #975
Claim: cloud/i817-sonnet
Author model: sonnet-5.5 (cloud/i817-sonnet)
Reviewer model: opus (cloud/r962-opus-delta)

### Problem
The default topic rows (Favoris, Drapeaux, category lists, search) showed the starter, a reply count, a dot and flag icons. Operator decision of 2026-11-16 (#817): parity with the current app. Separately (#975), the Favoris tab's title bar said « Drapeaux » on the `.flagged` source.

### Cause
`TopicRowView` was the dense row only; the last poster was parsed (`TopicSummary.lastPost`) but not shown. `TopicListView` titled the screen with `TopicSource.title`, which is « Drapeaux » for `.flagged`.

### Change
- `LegacyTopicRowView` (new default): pin (red) and lock before the title on one or two lines, unread-pages pill on the right, info line « ⚑ lue / total » (or « N pages ») left and « dernier posteur - date » right; no star, no reply count, no starter; VoiceOver says « Non lu », « Super favori » and the tinted flag (« Favori », « Drapeau », « Lu »). Ports `MainWindow.swift:455-504` and `Common.swift:3608-3650` @ 87fe0d1c.
- `TopicRowInfoLine`: pure formatting, legacy's date rules (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454` @ 87fe0d1c): « il y a 13 min » / « il y a 3 h » under 24 h, then « 06/11/26 », « HH:mm » for a date ahead of the clock, all in Paris time.
- `TopicRowView` is now a switch on `TopicRowStyle.current` (`EXPERIMENTAL(flagIconRows, #905)`, default `.legacy`); today's row is `DenseTopicRowView`, code unchanged, for #905 to wire.
- #975: `TopicSource.navigationTitle` is « Favoris » for `.flagged` and `.favorites` (legacy `MainWindow.swift:1821, 2406`, `Favorites.swift:758` @ 87fe0d1c); `TopicListView` uses it. `title` is unchanged and still names the lists in the tab's « Liste » picker.
- Not touched: reader files, row tint logic (`rowPill`, `TopicListView.rowTint`).

### Tests
`TopicRowInfoLineTests`: dates (including the Paris-zone day and the « HH:mm » case), « lue / total », last poster (never the starter, date alone without an author), no reply count / starter in the default row. `TopicSourceTitleTests`: the Favoris title on both sources. `TopicFlagSpeechTests`: the spoken flag names. Not run here (Linux); the macOS compile-check runs on each head.

### Device-check points
- Favoris, Drapeaux, a category list, search results: title on 2 lines, pill, info line, date formats (< 24 h and older), light/dark, VoiceOver values.
- Sticky topic with an old last post: the trailing name is the last poster.
- Favoris tab: title bar « Favoris » on « Drapeaux & Favoris » and « Favoris uniquement »; the « Liste » picker still names both; iPad sidebar and split.
- Section headers with count and chevron: not changed here, check against the screenshots.
- A topic whose last post has no date: no trailing text (legacy `footerRight`).

### Ledger
```gap-edit
GAP-026
SwiftHFR final: Default row as legacy: pin and lock before the title, unread-pages pill, « ⚑ lue / total » or « N pages » left, « dernier posteur - date » right (« il y a 13 min » under 24 h, « HH:mm » for a date ahead of the clock, then « 06/11/26 »); no dot, star, reply count or starter. Dense row kept for #905.
Legacy ref: MainWindow.swift:455-504; Common.swift:3608-3650; ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454 @ 87fe0d1c
Source: port: ezzz Swift layer
Lot/Feat: LOT-082, LOT-169, #584, #817, #857
```

comments.body:
Reviewer model: opus (cloud/r962-opus)

**Adversarial review (Opus, cloud/r962-opus, aab2d72): REQUEST CHANGES**

1. **Medium**: `TopicRowView.swift:17,36`. The new markers name an option `denseRows` that does not exist. The real option is `ExperimentalFeature.flagIconRows` (#905: "carries `// EXPERIMENTAL(flagIconRows, #905)`"). Failure: someone removes the option, runs `git grep flagIconRows` as AGENTS §7 says, and misses the switch point and `DenseTopicRowView`, so dead code is left behind. Fix: rename the markers to `flagIconRows`. These comments still say the switch-off path is to come and are now stale: `TopicRowView.swift:55-57`, the `isListed` doc in `ExperimentalFeature.swift`, and the header of `FlagIconRowMarkers.swift`.
2. **Medium**: `LegacyTopicRowView.swift` and the `TopicRowView.swift:30` dispatcher. This is a VoiceOver regression. The dense row read "Non lu" and "Super favori". The default row now shows unread only as a semibold title, and a super favourite only as the orange pill colour (colour alone). The dispatcher drops `isSuperFavorite`. Fix: pass it to the row and add an `accessibilityValue` (non lu, super favori).
3. **Low**: `TopicRowInfoLine.swift:21-29` and the test at `:22`. A date ahead of the clock shows "il y a 1 min". Legacy shows "HH:mm" (`Classes/ObjCTopicListParser.m:431-433` @ 87fe0d1c). The date rules also cite no source (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454`). Fix: port the HH:mm case, or record it as a difference in the pointer, and cite the source.
4. **Low**: `TopicRowInfoLineTests.swift:24-25`. The "06/11/26" test date (12:00 UTC) gives the same result without the Paris zone; probe run with TZ=UTC and the zone removed. The test does not fail without the change. Fix: use 23:30 UTC, which must give "07/11/26".
5. **Low**: `TopicRowInfoLine.swift:18`. When the author is empty, the date is dropped too. #857 asks that "the rest" still show, and legacy prints " - date". Fix: show the date alone.
6. **Detail**: these docs are stale:
   - `TopicListView.swift:126-128` ("the flag's colour stays on its icon": the icon is gone);
   - `TopicSource.swift:11` (`title` is no longer the navigation title);
   - the GAP-026 `gap-edit` leaves Gap "ported with changes" and Source "new UX: spec".

   `LegacyTopicRowView.swift:13` declares `scale` and never uses it.

**Verified**: read the diff and checked it against the legacy code at 87fe0d1c (`MainWindow.swift:462-504, 513-517, 723-735`; `Common.swift:3600-3650`; `Favorites.swift:1095-1135`; `ObjCTopicListParser.m:405-454`) and against #817, #857, #905 and #975. SwiftLint `--strict` passes on the changed files. `ledger.py check-body` passes. Ran a standalone Swift probe of `dateLabel` on Linux. No reader files are touched. No other place shows « Drapeaux » as a title. App tests not run (Linux).

---

**Round 1 fixes, one commit (`3789b43`), each finding checked against the code first:**
1. All findings were real. Markers renamed to `flagIconRows`; the stale comments in `TopicRowView`, `ExperimentalFeature.isListed` and `FlagIconRowMarkers` now say #905 reads the option at `TopicRowStyle.current`.
2. `LegacyTopicRowView` takes `isSuperFavorite` and sets an `accessibilityValue` ("Non lu", "Super favori").
3. Ported legacy's rules (`ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454` @ 87fe0d1c): a date ahead of the clock reads "HH:mm" in Paris time; under a minute stays "il y a 1 min".
4. The zone test now uses 23:30 UTC (gives "07/11/26" only in Paris time); added the "HH:mm" and the sub-minute cases.
5. No author: the date alone shows (test added).
6. Stale docs fixed; unused `scale` removed. GAP-026 `Source` becomes `port: ezzz Swift layer` in the body's `### Ledger`.

SwiftLint `--strict` clean locally on the changed folders; app tests not run here. A compile-check on `3789b43` and an Opus delta follow.

---

comments.body:
Reviewer model: opus (cloud/r962-opus-delta)

**Adversarial review (Opus, cloud/r962-opus-delta, 3789b43 delta): REQUEST CHANGES** (head 3789b43)

How the six round-1 findings stand:
- (1) Fixed. The markers now say `flagIconRows`, the stale comments are rewritten, and `git grep denseRows` finds nothing.
- (2) Mostly fixed. `isSuperFavorite` now reaches `LegacyTopicRowView` (`TopicRowView.swift:31`). The dense path still gets all 4 parameters. "Non lu" and "Super favori" are each spoken once through `.accessibilityValue`, and `RowPill` adds no label of its own. See finding 1 for what is still missing.
- (3) Fixed. `elapsed < 0` gives "HH:mm" in Paris time. This matches `ObjCTopicListParser.m:428-430` @ 87fe0d1c: `substringFromIndex:13` of "dd-MM-yyyy à HH:mm" is "HH:mm". The source is cited.
- (4) Fixed. 1_794_007_800 is 23:30 UTC, which is 07/11 00:30 in Paris, so the test fails under UTC. The "22:21" check (now + 60 s = 21:21 UTC) also depends on the zone.
- (5) Fixed, with a test.
- (6) Fixed in the code: the `rowTint` doc, the `TopicSource.title` doc and the unused `scale` are done. For GAP-026, see finding 2.

1. **Medium**, `LegacyTopicRowView.swift:20-22`: the flag kind is still shown by colour only. In a forum list, a yellow, blue or red flagged row differs from the others only by its tint (`rowTint`, `flagPills` true). VoiceOver hears "⚑ 3 / 10", with no "Favori", "Drapeau" or "Lu". The dense row spoke these through `FlagIconRows.flagMark(_:).label`. This is the same issue as round-1 finding 2. Fix: pass whether the tint is shown (`showsFlag && flagPills`) and add the flag's label to `spokenState`.
2. **Detail**, PR body `### Ledger` GAP-026: in the `gap-edit`, `SwiftHFR final` leaves out "HH:mm" for a date ahead of the clock. `Legacy ref` still cites `Favorites.swift:988-1006; Common.swift:3095-3160` and not the code's pointers (`Common.swift:3608-3650`, `MainWindow.swift:455-504`, `ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454` @ 87fe0d1c). Add both.

No regression found. `String(format:)` and the computed `parisCalendar` are fine under Swift 6.

**Verified:**
- read `git diff aab2d72 3789b43` and the call sites (`TopicListView.rows`, `RowPill`, `ForumSearchView`);
- compared against `git show 87fe0d1c:Classes/ObjCTopicListParser.m` lines 405-449;
- computed the test timestamps with Python;
- ran `swiftlint lint` on Navigation, Experimental and the Navigation tests: clean;
- read the PR body through the REST API.

Not run: the app tests (macOS only).

---

**Round 2 fixes (`e378a7f`, then `4614700` for a line-length slip of mine in `e378a7f`):**
1. Real. `TopicRowCues.flagLabel` (« Favori » / « Drapeau » / « Lu », the dense icon's labels) is added to the row's `accessibilityValue` when the flag is drawn as a tint: `TopicRowView` and `LegacyTopicRowView` take `flagIsTinted`, set by `TopicListView` from `flagPills(for: source)` (false in Favoris, as legacy tints no flag there; false in search results, which have no tint). Test: `TopicFlagSpeechTests`.
2. Real. The body's `### Ledger` now says « HH:mm » for a date ahead of the clock and cites the code's legacy pointers.

SwiftLint `--strict` clean on `App/SwiftHFR` and the Navigation tests. Compile-check on the new head is next; I will not ask for a further review round (cap: one round plus a delta) unless the compile-check fails.

Agent : cloud/orch delta reviewer (Opus 5.5)

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/orch delta reviewer): APPROVE** — head 46147008 (delta 3789b433..46147008)

The two findings of the 3789b43 verdict are fixed:
1. VoiceOver now says the flag's kind only when `flagIsTinted && showsFlag` (`LegacyTopicRowView.swift:22-26`). `flagIsTinted` comes from `flagPills(for:)` (`TopicListView.swift:145`).
2. The GAP-026 ledger entry now gives « HH:mm » and cites `MainWindow.swift:455-504; Common.swift:3608-3650; ObjCTopicListParser.m:420-454 @ 87fe0d1c`.

**Details, none blocking:**
1. `spokenState` is private to the view, so no test covers the `&& showsFlag` rule. Fix, optional: move it into `TopicRowCues` as a pure function and test it.
2. `TopicRowCues.swift:38-45` repeats the labels of `FlagIconRows.flagMark(_:)`. Fix: have one read the other.
3. A few spoken values say more than the tint shows: a flagged super favourite, and the selected row. This adds information without being wrong, so it is acceptable.

- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 9 touched files: clean;
- `swiftc -parse` on each of them: OK;
